entries.english: For God so loved the world (John 3:16 — 1910 Masaba Specimen #164 & 1916 Luhanga Specimen #177)
entries.translation: Masaba (1910): Kubanga Were nagana kikyalo ari, ni kuhayo wahayo Umwanawe uwasaliwa mutwera yenyene, buli mundu yesi amufukirira aleke kugora, ne abe ni bulamu bukahwaho. • Luhanga (1916 Lk. 15:10): Toto mwene emusungīre mbu Balik'oya baryo mumonimwa Abamalaika aba Nyasaye.
